description: This file implements a PHP class 'ADODB_pdo_sqlite' which provides database abstraction and specific functionality for SQLite databases using PDO. It includes methods for server info, sequence management, transaction control, metadata retrieval and SQL dialect specifics for SQLite.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_sqlite
classes.description: The class provides SQLite-specific database operation implementations, extending the generic ADODB_pdo class.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver with the parent PDO driver, setting input binding and transaction capabilities.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information such as SQLite version and encoding.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Appends LIMIT and OFFSET clauses to SQL queries to restrict result set size.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique sequential ID, maintaining sequences in a dedicated table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table for generating IDs.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction mode for subsequent transactions.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table names from the database.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Returns a driver-specific format for a bind parameter.
